svg.title: Wien-Bridge Oscillator with JFET Gain Control
svg.desc: Wien-Bridge Oscillator with JFET Gain Control: schematic diagram using 1 op amp, 2 transistors and 3 diodes, drawn with generic symbols; the text below the drawing gives the design equations and notes.
